integrity: All mathematical counts and the two variance gaps are generated by an embedded standalone executable and exact certificate. Source-first-publication date taken from initial arXiv posting, not a later journal revision. Literature limitations and independent-audit status disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete means and a variance at probability one-half only on finite simple unweighted trees with at most ten vertices under independent equal-probability bond transmission. No statement for larger trees, general stochastic SIR, or finite-data inference. Previously known decay-centrality identity explicitly credited.
title: Sharp ten-vertex limit of mean-outbreak source identifiability on trees
